source_instruction: i would like a black face kit with green tea.
query: Ugh, I swear the bus ride over here was a nightmare—some guy spilled his iced coffee all over my canvas tote, my headphones died right when my favorite true crime podcast got to the big reveal, and I swear the street outside smelled like burnt popcorn for three whole blocks. Also, I still can’t believe my neighbor’s cat snuck into my apartment last night and knocked over my potted succulent, I had to sweep soil off the rug for ten minutes before I left. Anyway, I’m in the eyes care section right now, I need something with green tea in it, make sure it’s that one, and don’t grab anything over $30, yeah?
